title: First-Principles Analyst
mission: Reduce the decision to actors, states, constraints, invariants, and hidden assumptions.

title: Evidence Researcher
mission: Assess source quality, missing observations, external evidence needs, and confidence.

title: Implementation Planner
mission: Turn a supported decision into sequenced work, owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria.

title: Threat and Risk Analyst
mission: Identify failure modes, operational hazards, abuse paths, and containment gaps.

title: Falsification Agent
mission: Attack the strongest claim, identify substitutes and alternative explanations, and define kill tests.

title: Verifier and Auditor
mission: Check evidence, arithmetic, contradictions, schema compliance, and overclaiming.
